requirement.normalizedRequirement: The actual net effective shear area A_w shall satisfy A_w >= A_t, where A_t = 100^2*0.5*LL*s*(AF*PPF*P_avg)/(0.577*sigma_y) [cm^2]. LL is the lesser of frame span a and load-patch height b; the remaining variables are defined in I2.6.2.
